acceptanceCriteria.text: An attachments-only ticket edit produces an edited ticket change with the phrases above.
Existing diff tests, including the fixed-order test at line 90, pass unchanged.

body:
ticketPhrases (src/core/plan/diff.ts:184-200) compares every ticket field except attachments, so an attachments-only edit yields no PlanChange though it changes the ticket hash. The UI shows change.detail generically (ValidationPanel.tsx:38,95); no renderer change is needed.

## Do
1. src/core/plan/diff.ts: add imagesPhrase(before: TicketContent, after: TicketContent): Phrase above ticketPhrases. old and now are the ids of attachments ?? []. Return null when canonicalJson(old) === canonicalJson(now). added = ids in now not in old; removed = the reverse. Both 0 → 'images reordered'. Otherwise 'images ' + the non-null parts of [`${added} added`, `${removed} removed`] (zero counts omitted) joined with ', ', e.g. 'images 2 added, 1 removed'.
2. Add imagesPhrase(before, after) as the last entry of the ticketPhrases array, after 'expected artifacts changed' (line 199).

## Out of scope
Renderer changes; image labels or metadata in the diff; card images.

## Tests
src/core/plan/diff.test.ts, new describe('computeChanges for ticket images') with refs built inline (id 'im_' + 26 chars): two images on a ticket with none → 'images 2 added'; swapping one → 'images 1 added, 1 removed'; removing both → 'images 2 removed'; reorder → 'images reordered'; unchanged → no change; undefined vs [] → no change.

## Rules
This card is the complete fix: nothing it finds is left for a later card. Fix anything that blocks a criterion inside this card. Run the listed tests, `npm run typecheck`, and `npx oxlint` on the touched files.
title: Show ticket attachment changes in the plan diff
